description.en: Ability to correctly estimate the probability of a curative resection based on lesion characteristics (location, size, morphology, virtual chromoendoscopy features) and to weigh the benefit/risk of ESD against alternatives.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for estimation of curative-resection probability but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs estimation of curative-resection probability independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches estimation of curative-resection probability to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
